Item.Hint: Enter donation type group or select from LISTVAL, leave blank for all donation types.
Item.Label: Donation Type Group

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
:global.failed_item := :system.trigger_item ;
if :control_block.s_donation_type_group is not null then
 begin
 select description into :control_block.s_dtype_group_desc
 from valid_master_codes

 exception

 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if ;

ProgramUnit.Name: INITIALISE_WINDOWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN
 --:global.release_version := '1.01.01';
 --:global.release_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 -- [Ver: 01]
 -- [Ver: 02 ] -- IM 8497
 -- [Ver: 03 ] -- Removed Duplicate Objects
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 
 set_window_property('win_slots', title,'DSWVSLOT' || ' [Ver: 03 ] ' ||
 ' View Slots ' ); 

 if :parameter.p_site_id is not null then
 :s_site_id := :parameter.p_site_id ;
 begin
 select location_name into :control_block.site_name
 from fixed_sites
 where site_id = :s_site_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then message('Invalid site ID passed'); raise form_trigger_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
 if :parameter.p_dtg is not null then
 :s_donation_type_group := :parameter.p_dtg ;
 begin
 select description into :s_dtype_group_desc
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'DTGRP'
 and code = :s_donation_type_group ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then message('Invalid Donation Type Group passed'); raise form_trigger_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
 if :parameter.p_proc_code is not null then
 :control_block.proc_code := :parameter.p_proc_code ;
 begin
 select description into :s_proc_desc
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = :control_block.proc_code
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then message('Invalid Procedure Code passed'); raise form_trigger_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
 if :parameter.p_from_date is not null then
 :s_from_date := to_date(:parameter.p_from_date,'DD-MON-RR') ;
 :s_from_day := to_char(:s_from_date,'DY') ;
 end if ;

 if :parameter.p_to_date is not null then
 :s_to_date := to_date(:parameter.p_to_date,'DD-MON-RR') ;
 :s_to_day := to_char(:s_to_date,'DY') ;
 end if ;

 
END;

RecordGroup.Name: SITE_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select site_id,location_name from fixed_sites where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id order by location_name

RecordGroup.Name: DTYPE_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,description from valid_master_codes where code_type = 'DTGRP' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: PROC_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select procedure_code,description from valid_proc_codes where sort_sequence < 100 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by sort_sequence
